faq.q: What are Hex's security policies and controls?
a: Hex is built on industry-leading security and privacy standards that keep our customer's data secure while connecting, querying, analyzing, and sharing. Hex is committed to helping customers of all sizes meet their data protection and compliance requirements.
As evidence of this, we have obtained our SOC 2 Type II report, which attests to the effectiveness and our adherence to security controls and processes.
links: obtained our SOC 2 Type II report -> /blog/soc-2-type-II-for-you/

faq.q: What deployment models does Hex offer?
a: Multi-tenant cloud, including separate HIPAA and EU stacksSingle-tenant VPCs, typically set up to securely peer to your existing infrastructure. These are fully-managed.
Please feel free to get in touch to discuss which might work best for you.

faq.q: Does Hex work with large data?

a: Our Enterprise solution is a custom solution tailored to meet your needs. It includes advanced security, custom support packages, and a series of control features for large organizations.

faq.q: How can we get started evaluating Hex?
a: Anyone can sign up for a free 14-day trial of Hex's Team plan. If you'll require more time to evaluate Hex or are curious about our Enterprise plan, please reach out and we'll get you set up!
